definition: The electrostatic attraction between a lattice of cations and the delocalized electrons around them; it acts in all directions.

An element with a partly filled d sublevel in its atom or in at least one of its common ions; zinc is not one, because its atom and its $\ce{Zn^2+}$ ion both have a full 3d sublevel. Scandium fits this definition, because its atom has one 3d electron, though some books leave it out.
